description: React component for managing and displaying a list of tools, including search, view toggle, file upload, create/edit dialogs, and pagination.

methods.name: Tools
methods.description: Main React functional component for tools management interface.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles page and limit change for pagination, triggers data refresh.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches tools data with current pagination parameters.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles view style toggle between 'card' and 'list'.

methods.name: onUploadFile
methods.description: Processes uploaded file content to add new tool.

methods.name: handleFileUpload
methods.description: Reads uploaded JSON file and triggers tool addition.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new tool.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit selected tool.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Confirms dialog action and refreshes data.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search state based on user input.

methods.name: filterTools
methods.description: Filters tools based on search query.
